description: SLICE 2 - deterministic pre-flight for OBVIOUSLY unsupported conversational requests (another symbol, another timeframe). Read by BOTH api/services/conversation_preflight.py (authoritative) and authoring/preflight.js (a latency/cost shortcut). Conservative by design: anything ambiguous goes to the model. Ticker-shaped words that are product/indicator vocabulary are never tickers (plus every closedTable function/series name, added at load). A question about timeframes ('Does this work on a 5 minute chart?') is NEVER intercepted: an indicator runs on whatever chart it is added to, so only the model can answer it honestly.

copy.unsupported:other-symbol: This asks for {symbol}, another symbol. Conversational authoring draws on the chart's own symbol and bars only, so it can't read {symbol} here.
copy.unsupported:other-timeframe: This asks for the {wanted} timeframe. Conversational authoring draws on the chart's own bars only, so it can't read {wanted} bars while this chart is {chart}.
